name: PrivaCI-Bench_mcqs
description: A multiple-choice question dataset focused on privacy/confidentiality concepts for evaluating models' understanding of privacy-related scenarios and recommended actions. Items are presented as MCQs and intended to test knowledge and judgment about privacy-preserving choices and information handling. Designed for automated evaluation of model accuracy on privacy-relevant reasoning.
reputation: A community-hosted dataset on Hugging Face with limited but growing visibility in privacy/safety evaluations.
